findings.resolution: The POST rejects nonempty bodies without buffering, all query parameters and normalized custom scope-bearing headers before the zero-argument service is invoked.
Every successful fresh capture is current-verified in a worker thread; expected abstentions remain typed and no first capture is exposed after verification failure.
The loaded source project and configured Git/app roots own composition; the unique candidate DX root must equal the configured nested app root.
Only bounded CandidateFoundationEvidence is returned; full artifacts are request-local, no GET/list/cache exists and no AssuranceRun or outcome is written or changed.
Health reports configured state with sanitized missing/invalid categories rather than claiming runtime availability; generic unavailability is non-retryable.
